messages:
maria: Heads up: after yesterday's docs nav tidy, the quickstart breadcrumb no longer links to /quickstart/setup and the curl snippet on that page returns 404 when run. Has anyone seen this?
kevin: I noticed the nav change — we consolidated /quickstart -> /getting-started but didn't add redirects.
sasha: @kevin we should add a redirect. Which repo holds the redirect map?
maria: Docs hosting uses docs-service + a static redirect map in the docs repo. I can open a PR for the redirect map if someone points me to the repo and the preferred target path.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed docs nav PR #4331 yesterday at 21:03 — TOC/section move.
kevin: The curl snippet is literally:
```
curl -sS https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/setup | jq .
```
We should update it to `/getting-started/setup`. I'll open a tiny PR to update the snippet and add a quick smoke test.
maria: That sounds good. If someone can patch the snippet and add the redirect, we can close the broken-link alert and remove the automated pager. @ops can we add a periodic smoke for common endpoints?
sasha: I'll take the redirect. Creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1255 — redirect from `/quickstart/setup` -> `/getting-started/setup`. I'll add the docs-deploy label.
kevin: Opened snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1260 — replaces path in curl and adds a pytest that curls the URL.
maria: Quick review done, LGTM. Once both merged, can someone trigger docs-deploy? :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: docs-deploy queued by @sasha — build #202 in CI.
maria: Thanks everyone — closing the alert once deploy passes. :raised_hands:
